Declare one block of the manuscript, with its formatter and its items

Source: R/formatters.R
block.Rd

block() declares one element of the list blocks in <version>_functions/blocks.R. The function of the block returns numbers, and the formatter turns them into the text of the manuscript.

Usage

block(fn, format, items = character(0))

Arguments

fn

A function of results. It returns the raw value of the block: a data.frame or a data.table of numbers and labels.

format

The name of the formatter, one string. It is the name of a house formatter, or of a function in <version>_functions/formatters.R.

items

The checklist items that the block answers, as a character vector of "<id>:<item>" strings, for example c("strobe:13a", "strobe:14a"). The default is no item.

Value

An object of the class pbn_block: a list with fn, format and items.

Details

The rule set house_2026_11_26 and the newer sets need block() for each element of blocks:

blocks <- list(
  "Results para 1: effect" = pbn::block(
    function(results) results$effect,
    format = "effect",
    items = c("strobe:17")
  )
)

The raw value MUST hold numbers as numbers. A character or factor column holds labels only. No cell of such a column MAY match [0-9][.,][0-9], [0-9]%, [0-9] \( or \b[nNpP] ?[=<>] ?[0-9]. Each of these patterns is a formatted number, such as 0.80, 68.7%, 3 ( and n = 3. A comparison in a label, such as Education < 16 years, passes. save_results(), update_blocks(), show_blocks(), show_block() and txt() stop on such a cell. The error names the block, the column and the first cell that matches. The check reads the value only, so a block MAY call any function, for example paste0() to make a name.

The formatted value of a block is formatter(value). A formatter is a function of one argument, the raw value. It returns a character vector with one string for each row, or a data.frame or a data.table. Its columns MAY be of mixed types. pbn has five house formatters. Each of them uses the minus sign U+2212 for a negative number:

namecolumnsexample
ciest, lo, hi; digits (default 2)0.80 (95% CI 0.46 to 1.16)
ppp < 0.001, p = 0.047
effectest, lo, hi, p; unit, digits (default 2)(0.80 points, 95% CI 0.46 to 1.16, p < 0.001)
n_pctn, total; digits (default 1)1,037 (68.7%)
mean_sdmean, sd; digits (default 1)30.7 (4.8)

p gives p < 0.001 below 0.001, and else 3 decimals. A row with NA in a column that the formatter needs gives NA.

A project formatter is a function in <version>_functions/formatters.R. It wins over a house formatter of the same name. That file MUST hold only assignments of a name to function(...). A project formatter sees CFG and the functions of the functions folder, in show_block(), in txt() and in the file of to_one_file(). pbn leaves it out of manifest$source_md5 under the same conditions as blocks.R, see save_results(). So a change of a formatter keeps the results current. The rule blocks_list of check_project() fails a use of a name of formatters.R in a file other than blocks.R and formatters.R.

In blocks.R, format MUST be one string, and items MUST be a call c("<id>:<item>", ...) of strings, so that check_project() reads them without running code. An <id> holds lower-case letters, digits and -. An <item> holds no space and no :.

See also

show_block(), txt(), update_blocks().
